narr: Zion National Park had heavy rain and flash flooding along the Virgin River. Thunderstorms around Milford brought strong outflow winds.
ev: Zion National Park rangers reported multiple large waterfalls throughout the park. Additionally, the river gage on the Virgin River at Virgin recorded an increase in flows from 77 cfs to 1604 cfs between 12:00 and 1:00 p.m. MDT.
